text.short: A road crossing where red motes drift against the wind.
text.summary: Ashford Crossroads is the first place locals noticed the ember-sign.
text.full: Two roads cross beside a scorched mile marker. Red motes drift through the ditch in slow, deliberate arcs.
text.entry: You arrive at Ashford Crossroads as the wind drops to a hush.
text.sms: Ashford Crossroads. Red motes drift in the ditch.
